title: How Steve turns Double Calendar Spreads Into Risk-Free Iron Condors
summary: Steve Bernich (NavigationTrading) pitches the 'DC Time Machine': enter an SPX double calendar, then once it shows ~5-10% profit convert it in one order into an iron condor whose net credit exceeds the wing width, making the condor structurally no-loss and freeing buying power. The 'risk-free' label is true only post-transform (~60% of the time); the real, unstopped risk sits in the un-transformed double calendar. Write-up: strategies/dc_time_machine.md (conviction 2/5).
